description: Examine ONE recorded span (or a run's span set) forensically — canonicalization, env binding, completeness, stub coverage — and return the fork-safety verdict (FORK-SAFE-LIVE / FORK-SAFE-STUBBED / FORK-DEGRADED / FORK-UNSAFE) WITHOUT executing the span or forking anything. $0.01 per span checked on the hosted surface.

spans.description: A recorded run's span records; without span_id every span is checked.

name: fork_safety_check
